purpose: Blog-post title/meta header (author, date, read time, TOC card) at the top of a /blog/:slug article.

contentPolicy.note: All fields here ARE measured-real from posts.json — title/author/date/readTime metadata is real. Only the article BODY (content.article-body) is generated placeholder.

author-photo.guidance: Real named author photo (framerusercontent.com URL). Never fabricate a real person's likeness.
